review:
Two bonuses in one. Three money symbols on the middle reel start Hold & Spin with three respins, where everything else becomes money symbols – each new one pays everything showing and resets the respins. Diamonds worth 100x to 4,993x can land too.

Three to five scatters give 10, 15 or 20 free spins, where wild collectors grab fish worth up to 500x, and every fourth wild adds 10 spins. 5,000x max, 96.71% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
